title: The Wheels on the Bus: How Heavy Giant Wheels Spin So Fast!

lines.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round, all through the town!
lines.caps: The *WHEELS on | the bus go *ROUND | and round, all *THROUGH | the *TOWN!

lines.text: Ever wonder how heavy giant bus wheels roll so fast and smooth?
lines.caps: Ever *WONDER how | heavy giant bus *WHEELS | roll so *FAST | and *SMOOTH?

lines.text: A big bus weighs as much as two whole elephants!
lines.caps: A big bus *WEIGHS | as *MUCH as | two *WHOLE elephants!

lines.text: Inside every wheel, hundreds of tiny steel balls roll around an axle!
lines.caps: Inside every *WHEEL, | hundreds of tiny *STEEL | balls roll *AROUND | an *AXLE!

lines.text: These ball bearings beat friction so the wheels never get stuck!
lines.caps: These ball *BEARINGS | beat *FRICTION so | the wheels *NEVER | get *STUCK!

lines.text: The engine turns the axle, and the rubber tires grip the road!
lines.caps: The engine *TURNS | the *AXLE, and | the rubber *TIRES | grip the *ROAD!

lines.text: Round and round they glide, keeping all the passengers smiling!
lines.caps: Round and *ROUND | they *GLIDE, keeping | all the *PASSENGERS | *SMILING!

lines.text: Now you know the engineering secret behind The Wheels on the Bus!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the engineering *SECRET | behind The *WHEELS | on the *BUS!
